description: This Java class is a deserializer and validator for JSON input related to mapping product types (like loans, savings, and shares) to GL accounts in the Fineract platform. It performs validation on the JSON input to ensure required accounting parameters are correctly provided and references external GL accounts. It also contains specific validation logic for different product types (loan, savings, share) during creation, based on accounting rules. The class is annotated as a Spring component and uses helper classes for JSON parsing and validation.

classes.name: ProductToGLAccountMappingFromApiJsonDeserializer
classes.description: Spring component class responsible for deserializing and validating JSON input related to product-to-GL account mappings in the Fineract platform during product creation, ensuring proper account references and compliance with accounting rules.

methods.name: validateForLoanProductCreate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for creating or updating a loan product accounting mapping, ensuring required account IDs are present for various accounting rule types.

methods.name: validateForSavingsProductCreate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for creating or updating a savings product accounting mapping, checking account references and handling different account types and accounting rules.

methods.name: validateForShareProductCreate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for creating or updating a share product's accounting GL account mappings.
